findings.source_passage: Had I heard something clattering around in there? I leaned forward and squinted into the darkness.
findings.why_it_matters: The source uses an interior rhetorical question plus a deliberate physical gesture ('leaned forward and squinted') that establishes the narrator's cautious, self-questioning voice; the draft collapses this to 'A clatter made me pause,' removing the interiority entirely.
findings.suggested_fix: Restore the rhetorical question and the leaning/squinting beat to preserve the narrator's self-interrogating voice.

findings.source_passage: My body still wouldn't respond. Its only reaction was tears that pooled in my eyes and slid down my cheeks. My furious thoughts gave way to a loose grasp of consciousness.
findings.why_it_matters: The source explicitly establishes that the body's paralysis causes the tears—'My body still wouldn't respond. Its only reaction was tears'—linking the physical helplessness to the emotional response; the draft drops 'My body still wouldn't respond' and goes straight to tears, severing the causal and thematic connection.
findings.suggested_fix: Restore the sentence 'My body still wouldn't respond. Its only reaction was tears…' to maintain the paralysis-as-helplessness motif that is interpretively important for the kidnapping scene.

findings.source_passage: He pulled away the fake flesh that clung tightly to his brown skin. The nostrils of his nose bulged out like that of a pig, and his teeth were yellow and sharp at the ends like fangs.
findings.why_it_matters: The source specifies 'fake flesh that clung tightly to his brown skin'—the brown skin detail is characterizing and specific—and 'sharp at the ends like fangs' is the precise simile; the draft loses both 'brown skin' and 'like fangs,' reducing a distinctive monster-reveal to generic description.
findings.suggested_fix: Restore 'brown skin' and 'like fangs' to preserve the specific horror-register phrasing of the reveal.

summary: No high-severity signature losses; two medium findings (interior voice flattening at the alley approach and the causal paralysis-tears link at the climax) and one low finding (specificity loss in the Blake reveal) that collectively fall below the regeneration threshold.
